elaine_cs: Quick heads-up  EU Dedicated onboarding showed elevated latency and intermittent 502s 2026-03-25 09:0709:32 UTC. Affected: T-9210, T-9221, T-9233.

noah_support: Saw spike at 09:08. Triggered region failover to standby at 09:14; error rate dropped ~70% but some onboarding jobs still lagging.

tariq_eng: Preliminary: batching scheduler regression under multipart payloads caused worker churn. Applied emergency cap (max_batches=5) and restarted workers at 09:18. Hotfix under review, ETA ~2.5h.

elaine_cs: Draft outgoing note below  short, empathetic, offers remediation and credit. Please review:

elaine_cs: ```Hi <CustomerContact>,

Were writing about a transient issue in our EU Dedicated environment on Mar 25 between 09:0709:32 UTC. Some onboarding and ingest requests experienced higher latency and occasional 502 responses which may have delayed onboarding completion.

What we did: routed traffic to a standby pool, restarted affected workers, and applied temporary batching limits.

How we can help: we can re-run stalled onboarding batches for you, schedule a 30-minute troubleshooting session with an integration engineer, and apply a one-time billing credit to offset retry-related compute. If cross-region failover is acceptable, we can temporarily route your traffic to our global pool; otherwise we will coordinate EU-only options.

Self-help: temporarily reduce `batch_size` to 4 and add a short `retry_backoff` (200ms) while we finish the patch.

Next steps: we will publish an RCA within 48 hours after verification.

Regards,
Elaine on behalf of Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

noah_support: Suggest adding a line about data residency: "If you require EU-only handling, reply and we will not enable cross-region failover without explicit approval."

julia_billing: Approved credit phrasing: "A one-time credit equal to estimated retry compute during the impacted window will be applied to your next invoice." Legal ok.

inc_bot: Incident created: 2026-03-25-EU-Onboard-Transient (P2). Lead: tariq_eng.

elaine_cs: Sending localized EN/FR/DE copies and tagging renewals for T-9233 as high-touch. Will paste sent copy and recipients here once done. Thanks all :thumbsup:
